name: daily-song-list
description: Hourly YouTube timestamp song-list snapshots for 72H and one-month views.

scripts.update: node scripts/update-songlist.js && node scripts/apply-song-search-niche.js && node scripts/build-review-queue.js && node scripts/export-dirty-candidates.js && node scripts/build-runtime-data.js
scripts.rebuild:derived: node scripts/rebuild-derived-data.js && node scripts/build-review-queue.js && node scripts/export-dirty-candidates.js && node scripts/build-runtime-data.js
scripts.check: node scripts/check-js-syntax.js && npm test && npm run validate && npm run check:budget
